flows:
Navigate to https://www.colorhexa.com/ff6600 then Use Tab, Shift+Tab, arrow keys, Page Up, Page Down, Home, End, text entry, Space and Enter only.
Stay on this public site.
Do not sign in, register, pay, or interact with a CAPTCHA or access challenge.
Leave fixture settings unchanged.
Use visible controls only.
Open the color picker using the swatch next to the color search field.
Stop when the color spectrum panel and hue slider are visible.

wait: Waiting after confirming the swatch is not keyboard reachable

summary:
The visible color swatch next to the search field is not included in keyboard focus order, leaving no allowed keyboard action that can activate it.
Make the color swatch a keyboard-focusable button and let Enter and Space open the picker. Verify that Tab reaches it and that the color spectrum and hue slider appear after activation.
evidence: objective_contradiction: Tab and Shift+Tab skip the swatch, so keyboard-only constraints prevent opening it.
one_liner: The color-picker swatch cannot be reached with Tab or Shift+Tab, so a keyboard-only user cannot open the required picker.
